user.title: ADSB Aircraft Tracker Setup
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should receive ADS-B aircraft data. You can read directly from a local aircraft.json file or connect to an ADS-B feeder over HTTP.

data_description.data_source: Choose Local file when aircraft.json is available inside Home Assistant, for example /config/data/aircraft.json. Choose HTTP to connect directly to a dump1090/tar1090-compatible feeder.
data_description.adsb_file_path: Full path to the aircraft.json file inside Home Assistant. Example: /config/data/aircraft.json.
data_description.adsb_host: IP address or hostname of your ADS-B feeder. Only required when using HTTP.
data_description.adsb_port: Port where your feeder serves aircraft data. Default is 8085 for tar1090. Only required when using HTTP.
data_description.update_interval: How often to refresh aircraft data. Recommended: 10 seconds (range: 5-300).
data_description.distance_limit: Maximum distance to track aircraft. Units (miles/kilometers) depend on your Home Assistant unit system. Set to 0 for unlimited range.

summary.title: Setup Complete!
summary.description:
{summary_text}

Your ADS-B data source has been validated successfully. You can now choose to configure notifications or finish the basic setup.

notifications.title: Configure Key Notifications
notifications.description: Set up the most important alerts for your ADS-B tracker. You can configure additional settings later in the integration options.

data_description.notification_device: Select your mobile device to receive aircraft alerts. Leave empty to disable notifications. Only shows devices with the Home Assistant mobile app installed.
data_description.external_url: Optional website URL to open when tapping notification alerts. In local-file mode there is no ADS-B web interface unless you explicitly configure one.
data_description.military_notifications: Get notified when military aircraft are detected nearby.
data_description.emergency_notifications: Receive immediate alerts for aviation emergency codes: 7700 (general emergency), 7600 (radio failure), and 7500 (hijack).
data_description.close_aircraft_enabled: Receive alerts when aircraft pass very close overhead or at low altitude.

error.connection_refused: Connection refused by your ADS-B feeder. Verify that the feeder is running and the port number is correct.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. The ADS-B feeder may be unreachable from Home Assistant. Verify the IP address and port.
error.cannot_resolve: Could not resolve hostname. Check for typos in the address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the ADS-B source. Check the configured source and network connection.
error.invalid_host: Connected to the host but received an unexpected response. This may not be an ADS-B feeder, or the port may be serving a different application.
error.invalid_adsb_data: The source was reached successfully but does not contain valid ADS-B data. Ensure the aircraft.json file or HTTP endpoint contains valid ADS-B data.

abort.already_configured: This ADS-B source is already configured.

init.title: ADSB Aircraft Tracker Settings
init.description: Fine-tune your aircraft tracking experience. Current source: **{current_host}:{current_port}**

basic_settings.title: Basic Connection & Data Settings
basic_settings.description: Configure how often data is updated and the tracking range for your ADS-B source.

data_description.update_interval: How frequently to refresh aircraft data, in seconds. Recommended: 10 seconds. Range: 5-300 seconds.
data_description.distance_limit: Maximum tracking range. Units (miles/kilometers) depend on your Home Assistant system setting. Set to 0 for unlimited range.

notifications_settings.title: Notifications & Alert Settings
notifications_settings.description: Configure aircraft alerts and notifications. You need the Home Assistant mobile app installed to receive mobile notifications.

data_description.notification_device: Select your mobile device to receive aircraft alerts. Leave empty to disable notifications.
data_description.external_url: Optional website URL to open when tapping notification alerts. Leave empty if using only the local aircraft.json source.
data_description.military_notifications: Get notified when military aircraft are detected nearby.
data_description.close_aircraft_enabled: Receive alerts when aircraft pass very close overhead or at low altitude.
data_description.close_aircraft_distance: Maximum distance for close aircraft notifications. Units match your Home Assistant system setting.
data_description.close_aircraft_altitude: Maximum altitude for close aircraft notifications, in feet.
data_description.emergency_notifications: Receive alerts for aviation emergency codes: 7700, 7600, and 7500.

refresh_data.name: Refresh Data
refresh_data.description: Manually refresh aircraft data from the configured ADS-B source

send_test_notification.name: Send Test Notification
send_test_notification.description: Send a test notification to verify your device setup

install_sentences.name: Install Voice Sentences
install_sentences.description: Install custom sentence triggers for aircraft voice queries. Restart Home Assistant after running for sentences to take effect.
